verdict.rationale: Drata is a compliance SaaS platform that could plausibly host an AI assistant able to consume external MCP tools, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Drata exposing itself to AI agents through an official MCP server and its API, which is the server role. Its custom connections are API-based integrations, not MCP client support, so nothing shows Drata can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools.
